description:
Plan: /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-3sy.8-9.html (approved 2026-11-13, with fz-3sy.9; the two land together, stacked). lib/exceptions/ declares with defexception every exception fz raises (22 modules) with Elixir's fields and Elixir's message/1. Kernel.raise/1,2 is Elixir's macro: raise Mod, attrs is the raise of Mod.exception(attrs); raise msg is RuntimeError; raise of a struct literal raises that struct; raise 42 is ArgumentError. Library raise sites write the struct out: raise(%KeyError{key: key, term: map}). defexception's exception/1 of a text builds the struct directly. fz_raise and the functions raise/1 and raise/2 go. struct!/2 stores each field with a map update.

Measured (interp, a59d95d01): hello world 213 -> 257 jobs; OptionParser distiller 12,892 -> 13,129 jobs, largest drive 49,760 -> 49,875 of a 50,000 budget. Authorized pin rises (2026-11-13): hello world 213 -> 257; distiller largest drive 49,760 -> 49,875 with its totals; backend_inventory_width 44 -> 45; a_stream_over_any_enumerable activations 140 -> 141; root_entries_and_caller_discovered_callees 2 -> 5; runtime_demand_order_fixtures 175 -> 178; target_fixture_public_causal 1325 -> 1340. Any other rise is reported first.

Needs: fz-3sy.24 (guard rule) and the coordinator's fix to drive_depth (a product drive served by the bare drive defers to it); without the latter about 29 harness drive tests fail DependencyFailed.

Acceptance: a program raising one KeyError compiles only KeyError of the declared exceptions; oracle fixtures on three paths (each exception caught and its fields read; raise in its four forms); fixtures 00852, 00880, 00884 read Exception.message(e).
title: Built-in exceptions are declared in lib with Elixir's fields, and raise is Elixir's macro
